market.question: Will any Category 4 hurricane make landfall in the US in before 2027?

assessment.reasoning: CSU/NOAA forecast 2026 hurricane season slightly below average with El Nino likely (32% chance major hurricane US landfall). Question requires Cat 4+ specifically (subset of major). Historical base rate of any Cat 4+ landfall ~25-35% in average years; below-average year with El Nino suggests ~0.25-0.30.
assessment.key_uncertainty: El Nino strength and shear environment; one well-placed Cat 4 settles it but seasonal dynamics suppress probability.
